# Brite

A small, curious lamp robot with a personality. Brite watches through a webcam, notices when someone walks up, and reacts out loud, powered by Google Gemini.

## Features

* Detects faces from a live webcam feed
* Reacts with speech, emotion, and a pastel light color generated by Gemini
* Speaks out loud using offline text-to-speech
* Falls back to a calm default reaction if the API fails

## Tech Stack

* Language: Python
* AI: Google Gemini (`google-genai`)
* Vision: OpenCV, MediaPipe
* Voice: pyttsx3

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

* Python 3.9+
* A webcam
* A Gemini API key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

### Installation

```
git clone https://github.com/Varshini221/Brite.git
cd Brite
pip install google-genai python-dotenv opencv-python mediapipe pyttsx3
```

Create a `.env` file in the project folder:

```
GEMINI_API_KEY=your_api_key_here
```

Then run:

```
python main.py
```

The face detection model downloads automatically on first run. Press `q` in the video window to quit.

## Project Structure

```
Brite/
├── main.py         # Webcam loop and face detection
├── brain.py        # Gemini personality and JSON reactions
├── voice.py        # Text-to-speech
├── .env            # API key (not committed)
└── blaze_face_short_range.tflite   # Face detection model (auto-downloaded)
```
